harnessAdaptations: Expected source updated to bbf8475e80d59754bef4df4448492979f492624c; published bytes verified against that commit before launch.
Follow/hold recipients exclude destroyed vehicles and current chosen leader (v.id after any control handover), avoiding deliberate unavailable/self-follow commands.
Old evidence retained separately; current raw retention is work/armored-v2-stability.

coverageLimits: Software SwiftShader at 960x600; no hardware performance conclusion.
Entity counts are detached visible projection counts, not total live ECS or GPU allocations.
JS heap is CDP heap usage without forced garbage collection; fluctuations do not establish leak freedom.
GPU memory, resource residency, renderer geometry/texture counters, hardware VRAM and thermal/power data are unavailable.
Native RAF elapsed times are retained; no private ticks, RAF replacement, altered content, or fabricated checkpoint state.
This bounded observation is not full Q03 acceptance or reference-fidelity evidence.
